summary: Iteration 2 validated the 4 new enhancements: (1) Share Cards Cloudinary endpoint, (2) Bilingual Gujarati titles, (3) Reptiles series scaffold, (4) Bodoni Moda hero font. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passed, including new tests for share-card URL/image fetch, title_gu presence/non-ASCII, Reptiles collection in /api/site, and title_gu persistence via PUT. critical_code_review_comments: server.py photo_share_card: title is passed verbatim into a Cloudinary text overlay URL. If a title contains '/' or '#' the URL could break — currently safe (all seed titles URL-encode via Cloudinary SDK, verified with 'The Leopard\'s Gaze' encoding correctly). Consider sanitising/limiting length (>60 chars would overflow the crop:fit). Non-blocking.

server.py photo_share_card returns raw image_url when public_id is missing — front-end share flow assumes it is the share card; may want to still overlay for consistency, or explicitly document behaviour.
server.py: SEED_PHOTOS still has a redundant order-rewrite loop (flagged in iteration 1, not addressed).

share.js fallback (new-tab + navigator.clipboard) will silently fail in browsers that block clipboard on non-secure contexts; toast messaging appears correct in the observed run ('Share card opened — link copied…').
